founder.client.title: Why Taxi Food?
founder.client.p1a: My name is Christopher, a business developer based in Nosy Be since December 2025. I set up
founder.client.p1b: here, the platform that takes care of travellers from A to Z: airport transfer, accommodation, rentals, excursions — and now food.
founder.client.p2: Two things kept coming back. Residents told me they would love to eat the way you eat in Ambatoloaka, minus the noise, the scene and the crowds. And travellers, every single time, asked me where to eat, which places are worth it, who to trust — and whether anyone delivered.
founder.client.p3: So I tried it myself. Most restaurants do not deliver. You send a badjaj — the local tuk-tuk — and the order never turns up, turns up with a bite out of it because the driver got hungry on the way, or turns up cold.
founder.client.p4: That is why I built Taxi Food: real restaurants, real couriers, and your order tracked all the way to your door.
founder.resto.title: Who is behind Taxi Food?
founder.resto.p1a: My name is Christopher, a business developer based in Nosy Be since December 2025. I set up
founder.resto.p1b: here, the platform that supports travellers from A to Z: airport transfer, accommodation, rentals, excursions — and now food.
founder.resto.p2: That is where all of this came from. The travellers I welcome ask me the same thing every time: where to eat, which are the good tables in Ambatoloaka, who to trust. And residents want your cooking, but without the noise of the neighbourhood. The demand is already there. What is missing is the route between your kitchen and them.
founder.resto.p3: I wanted to check before building anything: I ordered myself, here. Few restaurants deliver, and when you send a badjaj — the local tuk-tuk — the order never arrives, arrives with a bite out of it, or arrives cold. That is good for nobody — and it is your name on it, not the driver's.
founder.resto.p4: Taxi Food fixes exactly that: our own couriers, the order written down in black and white, the customer pinpointed by location. You cook, we handle the rest. La Cabane was the first to trust me.
founder.photoAlt: Christopher, the founder of Taxi Food, in a black Taxi Food polo shirt on the terrace of a beachside pizzeria in Nosy Be, with a pizza oven and a delivery scooter behind him.
